name: real-skills
description: Everyday engineering skills built on compressed agent reports and a deterministic harness with Jev judgments: /real-skills:do-shit (tracker items to merged PRs via role-based subagent teams), /real-skills:changelog (release notes from promotion PRs or tags, linked to your tracker), /real-skills:quick-ask-me (short interview that ends in an implementation brief), /real-skills:ask-and-create-specs (Jev-gated interview that ends in a terse, line-capped spec), /real-skills:wtf (read-only bug-report triage with a checked verdict).
